en: Himiko, good morning.
Nyeeeh...
<CLT=cltMIND>Did that mean..."good morning"?

What a pain... Why do we have to go 
to the gym so early in the morning...?

I don't know...but I don't think
it's anything good.

We have an important student council meeting
today, but this is gonna use up all my energy...
<CLT=cltMIND>An important meeting?

Now now, it's okay. You won't use up too 
much energy just walking to the gym.
Nyeh...

Hey, about this "meeting"...
Are you planning something?

Oh, yeah, sort of... Angie said we should 
have a party.

We were planning to play in the pool 
with everyone after this.
I see...
Atua said he wanted to play in the pool.

<CLT=cltMIND>...What a peculiar request for
a god to make.

Oh no! Now's no time to be standing 
here talking!

If we don't hurry to the gym, our faces might
get peeled off like mandarin oranges!

I don't like mandarin oranges.
Peeling off all the white stuff is a pain...

<CLT=cltMIND>The pool...
So that's where all the girls will be...
Aaugh!
Wh-What? Do you want something from me?

<CLT=cltMIND>Monokuma stared at me silently, intensely,
as though he were trying to tell me something.

Well? What is it?
If you have something to say, say it!

<CLT=cltMIND>Suddenly, a thought flashed into
my mind!
<CLT=cltMIND>A...man's...fantasy...
<CLT=cltMIND>Wh-Where is this thought coming from?

<CLT=cltMIND>Not from my mind...
From my heart?

<CLT=cltMIND>Yes, my heart! For I have
love on my side!

I understand now, Monokuma. You're
telling me...that it's time.

<CLT=cltMIND>The girls are going to go play in the
pool, which means they'll be in swimsuits.

<CLT=cltMIND>That *must* mean a zany-yet-romantic
scene will play out! And I'll be there!
<CLT=cltMIND>But...should I?
Yes
<CLT=cltMIND>Yes, I can't back down now.

<CLT=cltMIND>The power of love in my chest has
filled my throbbing heart! Full charge!
<CLT=cltMIND>I have no choice. I *must* go!
No

<CLT=cltMIND>No...
I shouldn't be peeking.

<CLT=cltMIND>I can't let Monokuma
manipulate me...
Are you unsure of something?

<CLT=cltMIND>Is it really okay to be doing
something like that? Tenko would kill me...

<CLT=cltMIND>I suppose that's just the situation we're
in. Everyone needs a break every now and then.
Good morning, Tsumugi.

Oh, good morning. Are you about to head 
to the gym too, Shuichi?

Yeah, I certainly don't want to
ignore a summons like that.

Right? If we don't all show up, he might think
we're not getting along or something...

Before, I thought Monodam was the most 
reasonable one out of them, but...

He's pathologically fixated on getting along...
He's even killed other Monokubs over it...

It seems like he was actually the most dangerous
one. One wrong step and he's full-on yandere...
<CLT=cltMIND>...What is she talking about?

But now's not the time to be standing 
around talking. We need to get to the gym.

<CLT=cltMIND>When I used the item, the vine suddenly
withered... How does that work?
<CLT=cltMIND>Pool Entrance Zelda gimmick plant
<CLT=cltMIND>So this is the key to the gate...
<CLT=cltMIND>Casino Door Hexagon Wrench Gimmick(Closed)
<CLT=cltMIND>Casino Door Hexagon Wrench Gimmick(Open)
